script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A" --quiet --check agent.condenser.kind eq LLMSummarizingCondenser
control-agent-server ws start "/sockets/events/$A" --name qa-f10-condense --duration 180
control-agent-server ws read qa-f10-condense --wait 15 --kinds ConversationStateUpdateEvent --contains full_state --expect-min 1
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/condense" --expect 200 --check success eq true --timeout 180 --save F10.condense-llm/condense
control-agent-server ws stop qa-f10-condense --wait 30 --kinds Condensation --expect-min 1 --save F10.condense-llm/frames
control-agent-server ws read qa-f10-condense --kinds CondensationRequest --expect-min 1
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/events/count" --query kind=$CREQ --check . eq 1
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/events/count" --query kind=$COND --check . eq 1
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/events/search" --query kind=$COND \
  --check items.0.summary matches '\S' --check items.0.forgotten_event_ids len-ge 1 --save F10.condense-llm/condensation
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A" --quiet --check execution_status eq finished
